planRows.shortDesc: Our resort on Ambergris Caye offers exclusive access to Belize’s only private Beach Club. Diving and adventure tours can be arranged by our tour operator.
planRows.headline: Private beachside service near San Pedro
planRows.locationShortDesc: Mahogany Bay Resort & Beach Club is located 1 1/2 mile south of San Pedro in Ambergris Caye.  Beaches, diving, and rejuvenating are our key features.
planRows.hotelTeaserText: The newest resort in Belize and only resort with a private beach club and features 10 food and beverage outlets for the best resort experience
planRows.directionsTo:
Upon arrival at Goldson International Airport (BZE) in Belize City, proceed to Tropic Air for a scenic 15-minute flight to San Pedro (SPR) on Ambergris Caye, which is 51 nautical miles from BZE. Contact reservations@mahoganybayresort.com to have us book your domestic flight to the island and/or your cab transfers from SPR to the resort.

Alternatively, there are several water taxi services available from the port in downtown Belize City to San Pedro, a trip that takes approximately 1.5 hours. To get from BZE to the water taxi port, you must take a cab for 10 miles (typically 30–50 minutes) that will cost approximately $10USD.

planRows.directoryName: Royal Palm Galapagos, Curio Collection Hotel by Hilton
planRows.shortDesc: In the Miconia Highland Forests, we’re ideally set in the Galapagos, a UNESCO Natural World Heritage Site. Our location features natural lava tunnels, giant tortoise sightseeing, an infinity pool, firepits, yoga forest, and stargazing through telescopes. Enjoy unique tours surrounded by endangered species and scenic landscapes.
planRows.headline: Unique oasis in the heart of Santa Cruz Island
planRows.locationShortDesc: Located in the highlands of Santa Cruz Island, a 45-minute drive from Baltra(GPS) airport, and 25 minutes from the city center.
planRows.hotelTeaserText: The Royal Palm is a secluded hide-a-way nestling in the lush Miconia highland forests of Santa Cruz in the heart of the Galapagos. Located only 20 minutes-drive from the bustling port town of Puerto Ayora, our guests can enjoy privacy, space and quiet seclusion in our 8 Standard Rooms and 13 Villas.
planRows.directionsTo:
Your trip starts from Quito or Guayaquil airport to GPS airport at Baltra island in Galapagos.
Once at Baltra a public bus will take you to Itabaca's Channel (10-15 min drive). At the channel a public ferry will transport you to Santa Cruz Island (5-10 min). When you arrive to Santa Cruz you can take a taxi to come to the hotel (30-35 min)
You can always request transfer service to info@royalpalmgalapagos.com at an additional cost.

There is one main road from south to North in Santa Cruz Island.  The hotel is located in the middle of island at the middle of the main road in KM 18 via Baltra.  
Since there is only one main road the guests can take any car up to KM 18 where the hotel is located.  From the main street a 5-10 min drive will take them to the hotel buildings.
